newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine airports, ports, hit by strike.
newsitem.headline: Argentine airports, ports, hit by strike.

text.p: Argentine airports and ports were hit patchily by a 36-hour general strike that began at midday local time/1100 EDT.
Flag carrier Aerolineas Argentinas said it had to cancel some domestic flights from Buenos Aires' Jorge Newbery airport, while its subsidiary Austral warned of possible delays or cancellations.
Aerolineas Argentinas flights from the city's Ezeiza international airport also suffered delays. But foreign airlines operated normally.

Shipping agents said that private docks throughout the country were mainly working normally. But they said Dock Sud in Buenos Aires had stopped work, and the port of Bahia Blanca in the south had stopped totally.
Some parts of the port of Rosario in Santa Fe province were working normally, as was the case in San Lorenzo.
The strike is being led by the CGT trade union confederation to protest 17.1 percent unemployment and government drives for austerity and more flexible labor laws.
